authors: G. Charizanos, H. Demirhan, D. İçen
title: Fuzzy-Bayesian multiple imputation (FBMI) framework for missing data with irregularities
validity_discussion: Discusses model vs. imputation uncertainty, noting standard ML/DL methods fail to quantify model uncertainty. "Our method explicitly addresses model uncertainty by combining Bayesian model averaging with fuzzy representations of uncertainty."

authors: Iffat A. Gheyas, Leslie S. Smith
title: A neural network-based framework for the reconstruction of incomplete data sets
validity_discussion: Discusses Rubin's MI framework, noting single imputation understates variability and leads to invalid inferences. "A major problem with single imputation is that this approach cannot reflect sampling and imputation variability... leading to statistically invalid inferences. Rubin proposed multiple imputation (MI) to solve this problem."

authors: Charlène Béatrice Bridge-Nduwimana, Salah Eddine El Harrauss, Aziza El Ouaazizi, Majid Benyakhlef
title: A Tabular Data Imputation Technique Using Transformer and Convolutional Neural Networks
validity_discussion: Mentions MCAR/MNAR and heuristic uncertainty quantification via latent averaging, but lacks theoretical inferential validity analysis. "By merging the statistical robustness of multiple imputation with the representational capabilities of deep autoencoders, our technique provides both practical, impressive accuracy and interpretable uncertainty estimates."

authors: Mihir Momaya, Gyorgy Simon, Sergio Duarte, Lisiane Pruinelli
title: A Novel Approach for Handling Missing Data in Multivariate Time Series Clustering: Case Study on Predicting Delayed Graft Function
validity_discussion: Mentions subjective classification of MAR/MCAR/MNAR in EHRs and potential bias from conventional imputation. "addressing large amounts of irregularly spaced missingness using existing imputation methods can lead to systemic biases if the type of missingness is misidentified, as existing methods do not account for different time window lengths."
